tools.description: Validate a proposed Pinax enterprise registry and optionally check compatibility against a previous snapshot. Does not publish or authorize access.

document.description: Pinax registry JSON text, at most 8 MiB

previous.description: Optional previous Pinax registry JSON text

tools.name: validate_pinax

tools.description: Build the four-layer semantic bundle: Croissant, CDIF, DID, ODRL.
tools.name: build_navigator_bundle

tools.description: Run the governed multi-agent Resilience Desk story with the full evidence chain.
tools.name: run_qglake_story

tools.description: Verify a TypeDID envelope's payload hash and Ed25519 signature.
tools.name: verify_envelope

tools.description: Import an OSI or Croissant document as an immutable application object. Returns a model_handle valid for one hour or until server restart. Pass it explicitly in model_handles on search/answer calls; possession grants access to the imported document, never to lakehouse rows.
tools.name: import_semantic_model

tools.description: Find datasets, fields, metrics, and ontology terms matching a term.

model_handles.description: Explicit model handles returned by import_semantic_model; omitted means no imported models. Central governed ontology discovery uses discover_pinax_ontology.

tools.name: search_semantic_models

tools.description: Answer over registered semantic models: search, plan SQL, synthesize, sign, and attach the OpenLineage run.

model_handles.description: Explicit model handles returned by import_semantic_model; omitted means no imported models. Central governed ontology discovery uses discover_pinax_ontology.

tools.name: answer_question

model_handles.description: Explicit model handles returned by import_semantic_model; omitted means no imported models. Central governed ontology discovery uses discover_pinax_ontology.

tools.description: Authenticate and authorize a bounded Pinax scan intent against a deployment-owned registry and catalog. Returns planning evidence, not rows or an execution capability. Requires a configured backend.

envelope.description: TypeDID invoke envelope bound to /mcp/plan_pinax_scan and the configured server DID.

intent.description: Exact ScanIntent JSON text signed by envelope payload.bodySha256; at most 64 KiB.

tools.name: plan_pinax_scan

tools.description: Discover table and column metadata allowed by Pinax and TypeSec for a signed purpose. Bounded, registry-bound pages; no catalog access, execution, or grant issuance.

envelope.description: TypeDID invoke envelope bound to /mcp/discover_pinax_tables and the exact intent bytes.

intent.description: Signed JSON: purpose, limit (1–100 tables examined), optional cursor; at most 64 KiB.

tools.name: discover_pinax_tables

tools.description: Execute a signed Pinax scan through authenticated LakeCat and Sail. Requires separate owner execution permission; returns bounded rows and owner authorization/lineage evidence after fresh release checks.

envelope.description: TypeDID invoke envelope bound to /mcp/execute_pinax_scan and the exact intent bytes.

intent.description: Signed JSON scan intent: table, columns, purpose, limit (1–1000); at most 64 KiB. No SQL, paths, tasks, or policy overrides.

tools.name: execute_pinax_scan

tools.description: Consult the host-maintained central Pinax ontology for reviewed meanings, aliases and table/field mappings. Signed intent contains purpose, query, limit (1-100), optional cursor. Returns authorized Croissant/CDIF metadata and ontology digest. Never publishes or grants execution.

envelope.description: TypeDID invoke envelope bound to /mcp/discover_pinax_tables and the exact intent bytes.

intent.description: Signed JSON: purpose, limit (1–100 tables examined), optional cursor; at most 64 KiB.

tools.name: discover_pinax_ontology
